title: Sparse-serving econ pilot: roadmap, field evaluations, and sprint deck
creator: Asha Patel
description: Objective: run a focused pilot to validate combined savings from sparse-serving patterns (selective batching, tiered KV prefix caching, and opt-in quantization profiles) for mid-volume customers. We will produce a reproducible playbook, an ops runbook for rollout, and concrete cost / latency impact reports to inform Dedicated pricing and the Optimize recommendations engine. Scope: 6-week pilot with 3 customer cohorts (PLG app, mid-market customer, internal sandbox). Exclude changes that require model architecture edits; only serve-side runtime and config changes will be tested. Success metrics: net token-cost reduction >= 20% for cohort A (PLG flows) while maintaining 95th-pct latency < 250ms; no >0.5% increase in generation failures or hallucination signals as measured by evaluation prompts. Secondary metric: tooling adoption signal from one customer engineering team (integration + feature flag enablement).
milestones: Week 0: Kickoff, finalize customer cohorts, sign NDAs where required
Week 1-2: Implement runtime experiment flags (selective batch thresholds, KV policy tiers, quant profile toggles); internal dry-run on synthetic traffic
Week 3: Field enablement for cohort B (mid-market) and internal; collect early telemetry and QoS metrics
Week 4: Iterate on thresholds based on latency/cost trade-offs; run quality regressions on canonical prompt set
Week 5: Expand to cohort A (PLG flows) with canary rollout and A/B comparison
Week 6: Final analysis, playbook writeup, exec summary and handoff to Optimize roadmap
deliverables: Pilot results deck (cost / latency / quality trade-off charts)
Sparse-serving playbook (operational knobs, safe defaults, rollback steps)
Runtime feature PRs and deployment checklist
Customer integration notes and sample feature-flag configs
Data export for Improve team: evaluation prompts + label sets
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Quantization increases subtle generation regressions. Mitigation: gated rollout with quality regressions and fallback to full-precision for flagged prompts.
Risk: Batching thresholds reduce tail latency for interactive apps. Mitigation: per-route latency SLO guardrails and automatic bypass for low-latency routes.
Risk: KV cache policy causes cache pollution for unpredictable prefixes. Mitigation: tiered policies with TTL heuristics and telemetry-driven eviction tuning.
